name: nft-accept-inserted-above-drop
description: insert an accept at the head, above a drop that was already there
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 drop

action.spec: nft insert rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 accept
